mutant.lineText: if (ctx.seriesContext && (m = /^(\d{1,3})(?:v\d)?(?:\s*[-.)]\s*|\s+)(?=\S)/.exec(s))) return { pattern: 'leading-number', index: 0, length: m[0].length, episodes: [Number(m[1])] };
mutant.nextText: if (ctx.seasonDir && (m = /(?<=\S)\s+(\d{1,3})$/.exec(s)) && !(Number(m[1]) >= 1900)) return { pattern: 'trailing-number', index: m.index, length: m[0].length, episodes: [Number(m[1])] };
